quotes.text: The $1B unicorn number feels like it's from 2015 — that's a pretty typical Series A/B valuation at this point.
quotes.author: ramesh31
quotes.source: Hacker News — Europe's new robotics unicorn: Germany's RobCo hits $1B valuation
quotes.extraction_note: Trimmed the question framing into a flat, quotable take on how meaningless the unicorn milestone has become. Observes real market drift without fluff.
